card.name: Digits in temperature values before degrees
card.fires_on: A digit inside a temperature figure, just before a degree sign or the word degrees. It appears in storage ranges and in climate-warming targets such as 2 degrees.

modes.label: Storage temperatures
modes.description: Digit within a Fahrenheit or Celsius range for room temperature or refrigeration.

modes.label: Climate or other degree figures
modes.description: Digit in a number of degrees, such as the global warming limit or an angle.
